An '''Audiobulb''' was the trademarked name for a device that played recorded [[Music/Legends|music]]. Its energy source was a highly combustible [[Battery/Legends|battery]].<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars Adventures 4: Jango Fett vs. the Razor Eaters]]''</ref>

In the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Audiobulb was considered a rare antique. Because of the device's combustible battery, it was no longer manufactured by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When the [[music player]] broke, it had a tendency to explode.<ref name=":0" />

[[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was the owner of an antique Audiobulb. When the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] infiltrated Groodo's opulent [[palace]]-[[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] outside [[Calamar]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]], Groodo's son [[Boonda/Legends|Boonda]] nearly broke his father's Audiobulb when Fett suddenly stepped in from a second-story window to introduce himself to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rodd]], the criminal-[[Politics|politician]] he was pursuing on behalf of [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]]. While Boonda was startled, the Senator was scared witless. Even so, Fett was immediately forced to contend with one of Groodo's [[Razor Eater]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name=":0" /><ref name="Star Wars Adventures 3: The Hostage Princess">''[[Star Wars Adventures 3: The Hostage Princess]]''</ref>

Jango quickly snatched the Hutt's antique Audiobulb and flung it at the droid's head. Clearly unaware of the antique's combustibility, the Razor Eater, whose name was [[Sparky (Razor Eater)|Sparky]], opened its jaws and caught the Audiobulb in its mouth. It was the last thing the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] ever caught. Fett closed his eyes as the Razor Eater chomped down on the music player, resulting in a blinding explosion of light and sound. All that remained of the droid's head was its lower jaw. The droid's knee joints buckled, and its body collapsed.<ref name=":0" />

Senator Rodd was captured by Jango Fett with the demise of Sparky and the Audiobulb.<ref name=":0" />
